waypoints.name: Downey Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From the Darrington Ranger Station, drive SR 530 north about 8 miles and turn right (east) onto Suiattle River Road (FR 26). Follow it about 20 miles to the Downey Creek Trailhead at about 1,440 ft, just past the Downey Creek bridge; park on the right (south) side, and the trail starts on the left. A Northwest Forest Pass or the day-use fee is required, and a free Glacier Peak Wilderness permit is self-issued at the trailhead.

waypoints.name: Sinister Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Hike Downey Creek Trail #768 about 6.5 miles to the camp near 2,440 ft, then take the unmaintained Bachelor Creek path, fording to the south side near 3,700 ft, over a pass near 5,900 ft to high camp on the ridge above the lake. Cross the col between the two glaciers near 8,500 ft, descend onto the Chickamin Glacier and traverse east beneath the peak to the bergschrund, then climb the 45-50 degree face and a short rock scramble to the summit.
